WhatsApp Privacy Shield

Open WhatsApp Web, then use the privacy shield beside the header title. If the title is unavailable, look in the top-right corner.

Choose ON/OFF, blur strength, and Messages or Entire chat. Messages reveals only the hovered or focused row; Entire chat reveals all matching messages while the conversation is hovered or focused. The header and composer remain visible. × closes settings; OFF removes blur. Refresh resets settings and enables blur again.

This is visual privacy, not encryption. Some content may remain visible. No data is collected or transmitted.

After installing, disabling or removing the extension, refresh existing WhatsApp tabs.
